g.title: JevPipeline
g.text: SMELTER with Jev: ordered graph construction, selection, evidence, and comparison
Solid arrows show execution. Dashed arrows show shared calls or retained artifacts. Python owns graph membership.

g.title: cluster_pipeline
g.text: A. Run lifecycle and document insertion

g.title: cluster_selection
g.text: B. Shared matching boundary: initial, recovery, and reparented paragraphs

g.title: inputs
g.text: Prepared canonical JSON + ordered manifest
New raw source: extract once and review before graph work
Minimal fixture: 2 documents, 4 sections, 4 paragraphs

g.title: validate
g.text: OFFLINE: validate manifest, source contract, positional IDs
No credentials or model calls

g.title: start
g.text: start --jev: require TypeSafe + generative-provider keys
Pin Jev model, config, code/prompt/Skill/dependency hashes
Freeze source inputs; create run and immutable attempt

g.title: paper
g.text: Process next document in manifest order
First document seeds groups; empty match pools cost no calls

g.title: mode
g.text: Granularity?

g.title: root
g.text: Paragraph-only
Create deterministic shared root
Skip structural judgments

g.title: mode->root
g.text: paragraph

g.title: structural
g.text: Section / subsection phase
Reuse stored unit questions; generate missing ones
Forward: each new unit chooses an eligible existing node
Reverse: each node chooses from all eligible new units
Both directions use B independently, without the other votes

g.title: mode->structural
g.text: section / subsection

g.title: paragraph_questions
g.text: Incoming paragraph phase
Reuse stored questions or generate with adjacent context
Candidates must share the exact structural parent
Initial candidates cannot already contain the incoming paper

g.title: section_rules
g.text: PYTHON: accept reciprocal top-1 structural cores
Keep other units as singletons; record rejected one-way choices
Reuse singleton questions; generate changed group questions

g.title: section_recovery
g.text: Structural singleton recovery: one frozen snapshot
Each singleton -> eligible established node (>1 member)
Each node -> all eligible core singletons, not only proposers
Use B, reconcile mutual choices, refresh changed questions
No singleton-to-singleton comparison or convergence loop

g.title: older
g.text: If an older section joins a shared structural group:
recompare its existing paragraphs in the new exact scope
Use the same paragraph matching and reconciliation rules

g.title: paragraph_match
g.text: Forward: each new paragraph -> eligible paragraph node
Reverse: each node -> all eligible incoming paragraphs
Use B for each nonempty pool

g.title: paragraph_rules
g.text: PYTHON: accept reciprocal cores
Allow only immediate-core adjacent paragraph fan-in
Reject fan-in chains; preserve paper/parent restrictions
Generate questions for changed paragraph groups

g.title: paragraph_recovery
g.text: Paragraph singleton recovery: one frozen snapshot
Use B in both directions; apply core + adjacency rules
Refresh changed group questions
Cross-paper core candidates need not be neighbors

g.title: more
g.text: More documents?

g.title: more->paper
g.text: yes

g.title: export
g.text: SUCCESS: export immutable revision
Graph, events/judgments, correspondence and singleton reports
Viewer dataset: manifest, source texts, final_snapshot.json
Update run.json current_revision only after completion

g.title: more->export
g.text: no

g.title: viewer
g.text: OFFLINE: local read-only viewer
Question Groups / Paper Map / Graphical Explorer
Select run and completed revision; no model calls

g.title: compare
g.text: OFFLINE: compare two completed runs or revisions
Match source IDs + identical authored text/boundaries
Membership/scope changes, added/removed co-member pairs
Singleton counts, question changes, provider/model settings
Standalone index.html + comparison.json
Shared-paper comparisons; agreement is not accuracy

g.title: request
g.text: One direction, one focus, eligible candidates + full evidence
Shared role policy and examples; opaque candidate handles
Empty pool: return null without a provider call

g.title: cached
g.text: Valid complete
judgment cache?

g.title: cached_result
g.text: Reuse validated target / explanation / quotations
No Jev or generative call

g.title: cached->cached_result
g.text: yes

g.title: pool
g.text: 1-254 candidates AND
request <= byte guard?

g.title: cached->pool
g.text: no

g.title: result
g.text: Return existing match-judgment contract to A
Save Jev trace + generative response + evidence
Python reconciles only after directional judgments finish
Evidence also documents nonreciprocal, ultimately rejected choices

g.title: split
g.text: Oversized pool: split ordered candidates in halves
Apply this same selection procedure recursively to each half
Keep up to 5 candidate IDs per final half distribution
Exclude NO_MATCH from the five; retain full candidate evidence

g.title: pool->split
g.text: no

g.title: choice_cache
g.text: Valid selection cache
for exact request?

g.title: pool->choice_cache
g.text: yes

g.title: rerank
g.text: Rerank the combined shortlist + NO_MATCH
Use the same size checks and selection cache
Never compare probabilities across independent halves
If the shortlist cannot shrink to fit: stop, never truncate

g.title: rerank->pool
g.text: same procedure

g.title: api
g.text: PAID: TypeSafe POST /v1/systemone
Pinned Jev version; one Choice named match per request
state = focus, candidate evidence, shared source-text table
criteria = candidate handles + NO_MATCH
Check call / cumulative input-token guards; no automatic retry

g.title: choice_cache->api
g.text: miss

g.title: selected
g.text: Selected NO_MATCH?

g.title: choice_cache->selected
g.text: hit: revalidate

g.title: contract
g.text: Retain raw response before accepting it
Validate model, exact options, finite normalized probabilities,
highest-probability choice, confidence range and usage
Cache successful selection separately from evidence

g.title: fail
g.text: FAILURE: save failure.json in the attempted revision
Keep completed revision, raw responses and valid caches
No fallback to a generative selector or silent data repair

g.title: contract->fail
g.text: invalid / unavailable

g.title: abstain
g.text: Return target_id = null, deterministic basis, empty evidence
No generative explanation call

g.title: selected->abstain
g.text: yes

g.title: evidence
g.text: PAID: existing generative match-role Skill
Supply only focus and Jev-selected candidate
Schema fixes target_id to that candidate (null forbidden)
Generate basis and source quotations, not a new selection

g.title: selected->evidence
g.text: no

g.title: quote
g.text: PYTHON: validate quote source, attribution and length
Up to 2 evidence retries; reuse Jev selection
Evidence cannot replace or veto the chosen target
Contract errors / exhausted repairs stop the revision

g.title: quote->fail
g.text: invalid

g.title: retry
g.text: After inspection: retry RUN (same frozen inputs/policy)
Replay ordered stages; reuse validated caches
New attempt, no deletion of prior attempts
Changed code/config/source requires a new run
Timeouts may have billed; process budgets reset on retry

g.title: limits
g.text: Limits and interpretation
Default: Jev 1.14.0; 24,000 request bytes; 500 calls/process
2,000,000 Jev input tokens/process; separate generative guards
No long-context opt-in, confidence threshold, or dollar ceiling
Shortlisting can discard a globally preferable candidate
Quote checks do not establish semantic correctness
